27: ## Phase 1: Model safety net
28: 
29: - [x] 1.1 RED: Update `tests/SGV.Tests/Persistencia/ModeloPersistenciaTests.cs` to assert SGV tables map to `src/SGV.Infraestructura/Persistencia/Entidades/*Entity.cs` CLR types while `AspNet*` mappings stay unchanged.
30: - [x] 1.2 RED: Add schema-invariant assertions in `tests/SGV.Tests/Persistencia/ModeloPersistenciaTests.cs` for current table names, generated columns, unique indexes, FK/check-constraint semantics, and EF Core 9/Pomelo metadata.
31: - [x] 1.3 GREEN: Create `src/SGV.Infraestructura/Persistencia/Entidades/` with `EntityBase.cs`, `AuditableEntityBase.cs`, and `*Entity.cs` files for every SGV mapped table named in `design.md`.
32: 
33: ## Phase 2: EF mapping refactor
34: 
35: - [x] 2.1 GREEN: Switch `src/SGV.Infraestructura/Persistencia/SgvDbContext.cs` and `Configuraciones/ConfiguracionComun.cs` to `DbSet<*Entity>` and Infrastructure base entities only.
36: - [x] 2.2 GREEN: Retarget `src/SGV.Infraestructura/Persistencia/Configuraciones/*.cs` to persistence entities, preserving table names, column names, keys, indexes, relationships, generated-column workarounds, and Identity exclusions.
37: - [x] 2.3 GREEN: Update `src/SGV.Infraestructura/Persistencia/DatosSemilla.cs` to seed identical values through `NivelHabilidadEntity`, `EstadoVacanteEntity`, `EstadoPostulacionEntity`, `CargoEntity`, and `HabilidadEntity`.
38: - [x] 2.4 REFACTOR: Remove direct Domain-type EF usage from Infrastructure persistence files without changing Application contracts (DbContext, Configs, Seeds, and the minimum repository retargeting for a green PR 1 base are complete; audit flow remains scoped to PR 2).
39: 
40: ## Phase 3: Repository and audit boundary
41: 
42: - [x] 3.1 RED: Extend `tests/SGV.Tests/Persistencia/{CargoRepositoryTests.cs,HabilidadRepositoryTests.cs,UnidadOrganizativaRepositoryTests.cs,PuestoRepositoryTests.cs}` to prove ordering, filters, and `Puesto` relationship graphs remain unchanged.
43: - [x] 3.2 RED: Add `tests/SGV.Tests/Persistencia/AuditoriaSaveChangesInterceptorTests.cs` for create/update/soft-delete semantics, sensitive-field exclusion, and logical audit names without the `Entity` suffix.
44: - [x] 3.3 GREEN: Add `src/SGV.Infraestructura/Persistencia/Mapeos/*.cs` plus updates in `Repositorios/ReadOnlyRepository.cs`, `CargoRepository.cs`, `HabilidadRepository.cs`, `UnidadOrganizativaRepository.cs`, and `PuestoRepository.cs` to query `*Entity` sets and return Domain models.
45: - [x] 3.4 GREEN: Update `src/SGV.Infraestructura/Persistencia/AuditoriaSaveChangesInterceptor.cs` to track `EntityBase`/`AuditableEntityBase`, write `AuditoriaEntity`, and normalize logical entity names.
46: 
47: ## Phase 4: Schema-drift proof
48: 
49: - [x] 4.1 RED/GREEN: Update `tests/SGV.Tests/Persistencia/RepositoryTestData.cs` so MySQL persistence tests can create persistence graphs without forcing Domain EF tracking.
50: - [x] 4.2 GREEN: Adjust `src/SGV.Infraestructura/Persistencia/Migraciones/SgvDbContextModelSnapshot.cs` only after model tests pass and no schema change is required.
51: - [x] 4.3 VERIFY: Generate a throwaway EF migration or idempotent script from `src/SGV.Infraestructura/SGV.Infraestructura.csproj`; discard it unless the diff is snapshot/CLR-name-only.
52: - [x] 4.4 VERIFY: Run `dotnet test` and mark this change ready only when model, repository, seed, and audit regressions all pass.
